# 1. Provincial Cadastral & Tax Audit (行省田赋清丈与税籍审计)
oe_gov2_cab_cadastral_survey = {
	ability = adm
	icon = taluqdar_tax_collection
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_3_discovery }
		country_rank_level >= 3
		num_locations >= 20
	}

	allow = {
		num_locations > 0
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_gov2_cab_cadastral_survey_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_gov2_cab_cadastral_survey_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_gov2_cab_cadastral_survey
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		tax_income_efficiency = 0.05
		global_crown_estate_power = 0.04
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.03
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_monthly_control = 0.008
		local_max_control = 0.08
		local_unrest = 0.02
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 14 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability < 0 }
				subtract = { value = 16 }
			}
		}
	}
}

				has_owner = yes

			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_gov2_cab_canal_goods_oversight
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH

	country_modifier = {
		global_production_efficiency = 0.05
		global_construction_speed = 0.08
		global_raw_material_output = 0.04
		court_spending_efficiency = -0.04
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_production_efficiency = 0.12
		local_construction_speed = 0.15
		local_raw_material_output = 0.08
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 10 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				add = { value = 10 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { any_owned_location = { has_canal_construction = yes } }
				add = { value = 25 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Imperial Viceroy & Exarchate Audit (帝国总督与附庸巡查审计)
oe_gov2_cab_viceroy_inspection = {
	ability = dip
	icon = cab_diplomatic_corps
	helps_with = "subject"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		num_subjects >= 3
		country_rank_level >= 3
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			num_subjects >= 1
		}
	}

	is_finished = {
		num_subjects < 1
	}

	country_modifier = {
		subject_loyalty = 8
		diplomatic_reputation = 0.75
		subject_income_modifier = 0.08
		diplomatic_upkeep_efficiency = -0.05
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 8 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { num_subjects >= 3 }
				add = { value = 12 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { any_subject = { is_disloyal_subject = yes } }
				add = { value = 30 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 6. Court & Estate Conciliation Envoy (朝廷与阶层怀柔调停)
oe_gov2_cab_estate_mediation = {
	ability = dip
	icon = alleviate_concerns
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		OR = {
			stability < -10
			has_any_active_disaster = yes
			any_estate = { satisfaction < 0.30 }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			stability < 15
			has_any_active_disaster = yes
			any_estate = { satisfaction < 0.35 }
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		global_estate_target_satisfaction = 0.05
		global_estate_satisfaction_recovery = 0.0015
		stability_investment = 0.08
		global_crown_estate_power = -0.05
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 4 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { stability < 15 }
				add = { value = 24 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { war_exhaustion >= 4 }
				add = { value = 16 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 7. Sovereign Debt & Mint Stabilization (国债重组与币制稳控)
oe_gov2_cab_debt_restructuring = {
	ability = adm
	icon = kazenny
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		OR = {
			num_loans >= 4
			inflation >= 0.08
			is_during_bankruptcy = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			num_loans >= 3
			inflation >= 0.06
			is_during_bankruptcy = yes
		}
	}

	country_modifier = {
		bank_interest = -0.010
		bond_interest = -0.010
		monthly_inflation = -0.0005
		minting_inflation_threshold = 0.04
		minting_income_factor = -0.10
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = -2 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { num_loans >= 2 }
				add = { value = 22 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { inflation >= 0.04 }
				add = { value = 22 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 8. Frontier Limes & Garrison Inspection (边疆防线与戍军校阅)
oe_gov2_cab_frontier_fortification = {
	ability = mil
	icon = settle_the_frontier
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
		num_locations >= 12
		OR = {
			at_war = yes
			country_rank_level >= 3
		}
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					is_border = yes
					has_fort = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_gov2_cab_frontier_fortification_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_gov2_cab_frontier_fortification_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				OR = { is_border = yes has_fort = yes }
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_gov2_cab_frontier_fortification
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		global_defensive = 0.08
		global_garrison_growth = 0.08
		fort_maintenance_efficiency = -0.05
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_defensive = 0.15
		local_garrison_growth = 0.15
		local_supply_limit_modifier = 0.15
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 8 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = yes }
				add = { value = 18 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 9. Urban Guild & Market Chartering (城市行会与商市特许)
oe_gov2_cab_guild_chartering = {
	ability = dip
	icon = develop_province
	helps_with = "location"
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
		country_has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate
		OR = {
			government_type = government_type:republic
			"estate_power(estate_type:burghers_estate)" >= 0.20
		}
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			any_owned_location = {
				OR = {
					location_rank = location_rank:town
					location_rank = location_rank:city
					location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = province
		source = actor
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_gov2_cab_guild_chartering_select_province"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_gov2_cab_guild_chartering_no_provinces"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			any_location_in_province = {
				has_owner = yes
				owner = scope:actor
				OR = { location_rank = location_rank:town location_rank = location_rank:city location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis }
			}
			NOT = {
				cabinet_already_performing_same_task_on_target = {
					cabinet_action = oe_gov2_cab_guild_chartering
					interaction_target = target
				}
			}
		}
		map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
	}

	country_modifier = {
		burghers_estate_target_satisfaction = 0.05
		global_merchant_power = 0.08
		nobles_estate_target_satisfaction = -0.03
	}

	location_modifier = {
		local_monthly_prosperity = 0.002
		local_trade_center_power = 0.10
		local_pop_promotion_speed_modifier = 0.10
	}

	map_marker = {
		show_for_owner = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 12 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { at_war = no }
				add = { value = 8 }
			}
		}
	}
}

# 10. Dynastic Chancery & Heir Governance (王朝御前文书与储君辅政)
oe_gov2_cab_dynastic_chancery = {
	ability = dip
	icon = strengthen_government
	allow_multiple = no

	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_isolated_phase = yes }
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		country_rank_level >= 3
		current_age_or_later = { age = age_2_renaissance }
	}

	allow = {
		OR = {
			scope:is_active ?= yes
			government_type = government_type:monarchy
		}
	}

	is_finished = {
		NOT = { government_type = government_type:monarchy }
	}

	country_modifier = {
		monthly_legitimacy = 0.08
		monthly_prestige = 0.06
		diplomatic_capacity_modifier = 0.10
		court_spending_efficiency = -0.05
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 10 }
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = { legitimacy < 80 }
				add = { value = 16 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_heir = yes }
				add = { value = 6 }
			}
		}
	}
}
